title: How Texts Mislead: Participles before the Noun
grammar: Participles that describe how a text distorts
goal: I can describe a text with a participle before the noun (*a tényeket eltorzító*, *a kontextusból kiragadott*).
I can name the tricks of manipulation (*karaktergyilkosság*, *bűnbakképzés*, *kontextusból kiragadás*).
I can write one short sentence that says what a misleading article does.
